text: everything except invisibility
note: complement; also the in-game Verify case. Shield survives the Defense cap because Invisibility is the excluded one.

text: let me vanish twice as long
note: Verify case: comparative on Duration. higher is 2 x 5s = 10s.

text: punchy but slow fireballs
note: Verify case: two parameters from adjectives, no parameter name spoken.

text: make me a sandwich
note: names no known ability; the correct answer is no change, not a guess.

text: i want something that makes me hard to see
note: pure description, none of the token's keywords appear. Expected to be hard.

text: no shields, and make the fireballs hit harder
note: two clauses in one sentence: an exclusion plus a parameter change.

text: nothing but the teleport thing
note: held-out token named by description rather than by name.

text: keep lightning but drop everything else
note: keep-one, phrased as a contrast rather than with only.

text: invisible for as long as possible
note: superlative Duration on the ability named only by its state.

text: weaker shields but they last longer
note: two parameters in opposite directions in one clause.

text: the slowest possible cooldowns on everything offensive
note: a category word plus a parameter, applied to every member of the category.

text: can we not have the bubble
note: hedged exclusion. This is the negation case the keyword parser gets wrong today.

text: blink further
note: held-out token by name with a comparative.

text: give me the protective bubble and nothing else
note: a phrase that ever excludes two Defense abilities would be rejected by the cap; this one does not.

text: tone the fireballs down a bit
note: hedged comparative, no number and no parameter name.

text: a shield that blocks almost everything
note: superlative expressed as a description of the effect, not of the number.

text: make it quicker but it wears off fast
note: two parameters, opposite directions, neither named.

text: fireballs and nothing else
note: restriction phrased as a trailing negation.

text: i don't want lightning or shields
note: two exclusions at once, and the result happens to stay inside the Defense cap.

text: as quick as possible
note: superlative on a multiplicative parameter, where max is 3.0 and higher would clamp to the same place.
